text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've been playing this puzzle game that's got everyone talking about how hard it is.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's surprisingly simple, but every time you clear a stage,
a new one pops up right after another—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I did, it just wouldn't end...
Before I knew it, morning had already come yesterday too...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The problem has just been swirling
around in my head non-stop... *yaaawn*.

Tokai Teio had sleepy eyes
all day long.
